entities.name: P00733 zinc carboxypeptidase
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P00733 from Streptomyces albus G; 255 aa, 100% identity and full coverage.
Catalyzes zinc-dependent D-Ala-D-Ala carboxypeptidation and transpeptidation in bacterial cell-wall metabolism.
Has weak beta-lactamase activity, hydrolyzing penicillin to penicilloate at low rate.
N-terminal signal-peptide-like sequence and curated localization indicate secretion; GO:0005576 extracellular region.

entities.name: PG_binding_1
observations: Pfam PG_binding_1 domain detected at positions 57-114 with i-Evalue 2.1e-15; consistent with peptidoglycan-related binding.

entities.name: Peptidase_M15_3
observations: Pfam Peptidase_M15_3 domain detected at positions 127-241 with i-Evalue 3.2e-29; consistent with D-Ala-D-Ala carboxypeptidase catalytic activity.

entities.name: Bacterial cell-wall metabolism
observations: The protein participates in peptidoglycan precursor processing through carboxypeptidation and transpeptidation reactions.
